scope: Read-only narrative and image audit; this JSON is the only output. No image generation, global indexes, source designs or game files changed.
method: Read AGENTS; searched every currently available manifest recursively (61) plus initial batch PROMPTS and all registered asset filenames; inspected exactly three relevant PNGs. Cast review coverage does not prove action-keyframe coverage.

sources.exact_requirement: 赫斯没有人替他挡价后可逃或独战，账页不丢。 / 守债簿、依赖辅助装置、断开后逃走或近战。 / 赫斯死亡或逃脱都留固定债簿。

findings.verified_image_coverage: Front/back/profile and one stationary forearm-on-closed-ledger pose. No stepping, turning or retreat sequence.
findings.outfit: Same older receding grey-haired man; dark charcoal long wool coat, bone linen collar, plain brown belt, ordinary iron operation key and worn brown boots. Existing lapels are too modern; retain silhouette but plain medieval closure. Key location must stay fixed.
minimal_keyframes: Fixed closed ledger and waist-high stone shelf; same Hers releases his forearm from ledger and shifts his body weight away.
Same shelf and ledger stay motionless; Hers turns toward open side and takes first retreating step, coat follows physical movement.
Hers takes next step away; closed ledger still visibly left in its original place, no carried pages, no disappearing character or completed-escape icon.
findings.guards: Conditional retreat branch only after apparatus is actually disconnected and branch selects fleeing; not every N17 outcome. No death, surrender, redemption, magical action, apparatus redesign or political outcome. Torso/step choreography is an art proposal, while escape branch is explicit source. No invented weapon or combat move.

minimal_keyframes: Start from existing neutral seated posture on the same stool, feet and camera registered.
Torso leans forward and body begins rising from stool; use a restrained chair-rise gesture, no weapon or assisting person.
Upright immediately in front of the unchanged stool, hands neutral. Stop here; no walk-off, salute or recruitment gesture.
findings.guards: Only when this scene’s actual individual payment/remaining-debt record conditions hold, and character present/alive/willing. Standing is explicit source, not evidence of healing, return to service or political consent. Preserve naturally covered legs; do not invent or expose brace/prosthesis design, injuries or changed mobility. Exact rise mechanics are proposed and require later animation review.

excluded: No generic idle/walk quota, no new jobs/combat, no retries of mechanical67/N6/door63/braid74. Existing Moren/Enna/Mia and other authored keyframe work not duplicated.
limitations: Targeted top-three audit, not exhaustive animation acceptance. References are appearance proposals, not canonical designs or native sprite sheets. No engine readiness/runtime claim.
